decisions.reason: A single-tube air fin cooler sits squarely within the firm's long heat-exchange expertise, so management can read early market feedback and improve the design through its own R&D and testing facilities.
The single-tube air cooled condenser builds directly on existing condenser know-how and fits the push toward efficient, lower-emission heat exchange, though it may overlap with Product C.

This second single-tube air cooled condenser is close to the core offer, and its overlap with Product B creates some chance of consolidation, but the related knowledge makes it easy to absorb and refine.
A liner for corroded tubes extends the lifecycle service business, where the firm's installed base and trained technicians give rich feedback for learning and improvement.
The customized industrial air cooler line matches the firm's strategy of integrated customized solutions and builds on deep existing competence across several models.
Tube end repair inserts complement the repair and spare-parts services and draw on proven heat-exchanger knowledge that the firm can apply commercially at low risk.
